The work runs from simple desk divorces to complex custody and property cases, with separate areas for mediation and arbitration, parenting and guardianship, and fertility and surrogacy. The team also takes on real estate, wills and estates, criminal law and Indigenous law matters. Andrew Koeman is among its lawyers, and the firm works within Alberta's new family law procedure for 2026 and the Family Focused Protocol. It operates as a collaborative team and draws on decades of combined experience with families and individuals.

about:
HNT Law is a Guelph firm handling residential real estate purchases, sales and refinancing, along with wills and estate planning for Ontario clients.

The firm analyzes paperwork, performs title searches and prepares the legal documents needed when a client buys or sells a home. Founder Hai Tran also teaches as an Assistant Professor of Law at the University of Guelph, with courses that range from Real Estate Law to Canadian Business Law. On the estates side, the firm has guided hundreds of clients through wills, powers of attorney and related planning. It serves both Guelph and Toronto.

about:
Randy Norris is a Mississauga criminal defence lawyer and former Crown Attorney who defends serious charges in Mississauga, Brampton and Peel Region.

A graduate of Osgoode Hall Law School, he began as a Crown Attorney in 1994 and moved into private practice in 1999. He regularly defends sexual assault, domestic assault, child pornography, theft and fraud, youth matters and impaired driving charges. He also advises people who have just been charged on release conditions, bail terms and disclosure. His office is in Mississauga, and he serves Mississauga, Brampton and the wider province of Ontario.

about:
Share Lawyers, listed in Calgary, is a long-term disability insurance practice with a Toronto base and service across Canada.

The firm opened in 1987 and has focused on denied and delayed disability benefits, both employee group benefits and privately purchased coverage. It deals with insurers such as Manulife, Sun Life, Canada Life, OTIP, Desjardins and Blue Cross, and has helped more than 10,000 people pursue benefits. Co-founder David Share has practised since 1985 and taught trial advocacy at Osgoode Hall Law School. Other lawyers include Steven Muller, Samantha Share and Janice E. Grevler.

about:
Kaysi Fagan is a Calgary criminal defence lawyer who represents people charged with offences ranging from minor theft to first-degree murder.

She has defended prosecutions at every level of court in Alberta and across Canada, including the Supreme Court of Canada. Her credentials are a Master of Laws, a Juris Doctor and an honours Bachelor of Arts, and she was formerly based at the headquarters of the International Police organization, INTERPOL. The office is on First Street SW in downtown Calgary, and she practises as a sole practitioner.
